meta.title: Paihuo
meta.description: Adds a dispatch mode: a manager session chats and delegates only, while engineers execute the work. Non-blocking manager, parallel engineers, workstations and queues, urgent jump-in, isolated worktrees, completion reports, a question inbox, todos, permission/model limits, plus a Codex subagent mode that calls the local Codex CLI directly, supports session reuse and messages, and includes a session-content menu.
